stemMd: Two fixed point charges exert a force of magnitude F on each other. If their separation triples, with charges unchanged, what is the new force magnitude?
explanationMd: Coulomb's law has magnitude proportional to one over separation squared. Tripling separation multiplies its square by nine, dividing the force by nine.

distractorRationale.c: The distance change affects the force.
distractorRationale.b: Coulomb force depends on inverse square, not inverse distance.
